# CANDIDATE: ORB_IMBALANCE_VWAP_REVERSAL

**Filed:** 2026-09-11
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A narrow opening range indicates volatility compression; when price deviates significantly from VWAP, a reversal candle often brings price back to VWAP, offering a mean-reversion edge. This strategy captures that edge by entering on reversal candles within a narrow OR that close back toward VWAP.

## Mechanism

Entry: If (OR_high - OR_low) < 0.2 × ATR(20) AND price deviates > 0.5 × ATR from VWAP (either above or below) AND a reversal candle forms (hammer if below VWAP, shooting star if above) that closes back toward VWAP, then enter long if price was below VWAP or short if above, at the close of the reversal candle.
Exit: Chart-stop at the opposite side of the opening range (OR_low for longs, OR_high for shorts), TP1 at 1R, runner trail using a time-based exit (close after 20 min) or chandelier.
Regime: Works best when VIX spot < 15 and after 09:45 once the OR is formed; avoid the first 15 min and the lunch-lull period (12:00-13:30).
